# KAN-142 Implementation Plan

## Goal

Scaffold a self-contained Astro 4 + TypeScript static site at `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/` that satisfies the product-deploy contract (`npm run build` → `dist/`) and ships the agreed visual chrome (dark theme, gold accent, sticky header, attribution footer).

## Approach

Astro 4's official static output mode is a clean fit for the deploy pipeline (`docs/product-deploy.md`): it emits a fully static `dist/` and works on Node 18 (the runner version). All work is contained within `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/`; the repo root `package.json` is not touched.

## Files added

- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/package.json` — `astro@^4.16.18`, `typescript@^5.6.3`, `npm run build` → `astro build`.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/package-lock.json` — generated by `npm install` so `npm ci` works in CI.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/astro.config.mjs` — `output: "static"`, directory build format.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/tsconfig.json` — extends `astro/tsconfigs/strict`.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/.gitignore` — ignores `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.astro/`.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/src/styles/global.css` — design tokens and base layout:
  - `--bg: #0c0c0e` (near-black background)
  - `--fg: #efe9dd` (off-white serif body)
  - `--accent: #c8a96a` (warm gold accent)
  - `--serif` Cormorant Garamond / Georgia stack for body/headings
  - `--sans` Inter / system-ui stack for header chrome
  - sticky `.site-header` with 5-dot nav styles, attribution `.site-footer`, and 5-section layout primitives
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/src/components/SiteHeader.astro` — sticky header: site title `Latvian Painters: Five Names That Matter` (with accent) and a 5-dot nav linking to `#section-1`…`#section-5` (placeholders).
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/src/components/SiteFooter.astro` — single-line attribution to `enciklopedija.lv`.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` — imports global CSS, mounts `<SiteHeader/>` + `<main><slot/></main>` + `<SiteFooter/>`, sets `<title>` and meta.
- `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/src/pages/index.astro` — five empty `.painter-section` stubs (I–V) inside `BaseLayout`.

## Files NOT touched

- Repo root `package.json` / `package-lock.json` — left alone per acceptance criterion.
- `clients/example/demo/web/` — reference scaffold remains as-is.
- Any workflow under `.github/workflows/` — the existing `jira-product-deploy.yml` already runs `npm ci && npm run build` against `clients/<client>/<delivery>/web/` and publishes `dist/` to GitHub Pages.

## Verification

Run from `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/`:

1. `rm -rf node_modules dist`
2. `npm ci` → exit 0, 333 packages installed.
3. `npm run build` → exit 0, emits `dist/index.html`.
4. `dist/index.html` contains `#0c0c0e`, `#c8a96a`, the site title string, and the `enciklopedija.lv` attribution (verified via grep on inlined CSS + body markup).

Both ran cleanly during this session.

## Risks / unknowns

- **Visual rendering not browser-verified.** The build emits valid HTML/CSS and grep confirms the colour tokens and copy are present, but no headless browser pass was performed. Layout regressions (e.g. sticky-header offset on small viewports) would only surface in a real preview. Recommend running `npm run preview` or the Pages deploy before sign-off.
- **Custom display fonts not bundled.** The serif/sans stacks fall back to `Georgia` / system-ui. If a specific webfont (Cormorant Garamond, Inter) is required for brand fidelity, follow-up ticket should add `@fontsource/*` packages or `<link rel="preconnect">` to a font CDN.
- **Nav dots are static placeholders** as specified — they link to anchor stubs but have no painter content yet.
- **Lockfile size**: `package-lock.json` is ~5.5k lines (Astro pulls in Vite + Rollup + Sharp deps). This is normal for Astro 4 and required for reproducible CI installs.

## Out of scope (future tickets)

- Painter content (text, images, citations).
- Real navigation labels / smooth-scroll polish.
- Webfont loading.
- SEO/OG tags beyond the basic `<meta name="description">`.

# KAN-143 — Painter sections, hero, bio, gallery, scroll animations

The five painter sections are now wired up end-to-end in `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/`. Each section has a full-viewport hero with ken-burns slow-zoom, a display-serif Latvian name with the English transliteration revealed on hover/focus, the life-years line in muted sans, a 60ch prose bio, a horizontally scrolling gallery strip with descriptive alt text, and a gold "Read on Encyclopaedia Latvija →" link. Sections fade-and-slide in via `IntersectionObserver` + CSS transitions only; no animation libraries.

## Spec gap, flagged

The ticket says the five `metadata.json` and `bio.txt` files are "pre-committed by the operator". They were not in the repo at run time. To meet acceptance criterion #1 ("All five painter sections render with correct data") this run committed fixtures under `src/content/painters/<NN-slug>/` for the canonical five — Rozentāls, Purvītis, Valters, Grosvalds, Padegs — with real names, birth/death years, and short encyclopedic bios. **`profile_image_url`, `gallery[].url`, and `article_url` are placeholders** (`picsum.photos` for images, a `enciklopedija.lv/skirklis/<name>` pattern for article URLs). Please swap them for the operator-curated set before the public deploy; the page structure won't need to change.

## What changed

- `src/content/painters/{01-rozentals,02-purvitis,03-valters,04-grosvalds,05-padegs}/{metadata.json,bio.txt}` — new content fixtures.
- `src/pages/index.astro` — imports all five `metadata.json` and `bio.txt?raw` at build time, renders the section layout, and runs a tiny `IntersectionObserver` script that toggles `is-visible` on each `.reveal` element (with a `prefers-reduced-motion` short-circuit).
- `src/components/SiteHeader.astro` — nav dots now have real painter names in `aria-label`/`title` instead of the placeholders.
- `src/styles/global.css` — added `.painter-hero` (full-viewport, gradient overlay, `ken-burns` `@keyframes` 22s scale 1 → 1.12 triggered by `.is-visible`), `.painter-name` hover-swap (Latvian out / English in over 320ms), `.painter-bio` (60ch, line-height 1.75), `.gallery-strip` (flex row, scroll-snap, thin gold scrollbar), `.painter-link`, and a global `.reveal` → `.reveal.is-visible` 700ms fade+24px slide. `prefers-reduced-motion` disables both ken-burns and reveal.

## Why

Pure CSS + a 12-line `IntersectionObserver` keeps the static-output contract clean (no extra deps, nothing to bundle) and matches the spec's "no external animation libraries" rule. Co-locating each painter's `metadata.json` + `bio.txt` next to its sibling files keeps content authoring obvious for the operator.

## Verification

In `clients/painters-demo/v1/web/`:

- `npm ci` → exit 0
- `npm run build` → exit 0, writes `dist/index.html`
